# milsymbol 2.0.0 (vendored)

`milsymbol.js` is `dist/milsymbol.js` from the npm package `milsymbol@2.0.0` (MIT license, see `LICENSE`), copied here so the trainers load nothing from a CDN at runtime and work offline.

Provenance: package tarball integrity `sha512-GcBFrcIUr8jScaZqZb0SI2W6AbnUrPCTHu2kqHxduQjN2DIN8q5pY6ksSWfnJ4HlcIAWQhyotbdPIr1bBxFbwQ==` (matches the npm registry's published `dist.integrity`). To update: `npm pack milsymbol@<version>`, check the tarball's sha512 against `npm view milsymbol@<version> dist.integrity`, copy `dist/milsymbol.js` and `LICENSE`, and update both `index.html` files.
